summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted the St. Joseph Herald's report that Tom Allen gave a boxing exhibition at Brady's Hall in St. Joseph before about 300 men, sparring with Harry Slater.

metadata.notes: masthead: Daily Democrat, Friday Morning, Sept. 3, 1869

facts.fact: Allen gave a sparring exhibition at Brady's Hall in St. Joseph, Missouri, sparring with Harry Slater before about 300 men

notes: St. Joseph Herald of the 1st says 'last evening', so August 31.
